findings.title: Static method references PRCommentWorkflow, which is not defined in this module
findings.body: get_merged_pr_single_issue_template is a @staticmethod on CommitContextIntegration, but it calls PRCommentWorkflow._truncate_title. _truncate_title is defined on CommitContextIntegration, and PRCommentWorkflow is a different class. Unless PRCommentWorkflow is imported or defined here with that method, this raises NameError or AttributeError when a PR comment is built. It should call CommitContextIntegration._truncate_title, or the method should be a classmethod.

findings.title: get_environment_info does an expensive event lookup per issue
findings.body: get_recommended_event() runs for every issue while the PR comment body is built. That adds a query per issue, likely a Snuba or nodestore fetch. The broad `except Exception` only logs at info level, so failures are silently hidden.

findings.title: Merged-PR comment template drops the culprit
findings.body: The per-issue line used to include the culprit subtitle. The new template shows only the title, a link, and the environment, so that information is lost. The format also adds a trailing newline to each item, which leaves blank lines between list entries.

findings.title: Applied migrations rewritten into no-ops
findings.body: Migrations 0917 and 0920 are changed to no-ops, with the comment that they "never ran". Environments that already applied them keep the data they created, while fresh installs get none. Together with the deleted migration test, this makes behaviour differ between environments.

findings.title: Default autofix automation tuning changed from "low" to "off"
findings.body: The default is changed in constants.py and in projectoptions/defaults.py. Projects that never set the option will stop getting automatic autofix. This is a behavioural change unrelated to the rest of the PR, and it is not mentioned in the description.

findings.title: Analytics recorded before the feature flag check
findings.body: analytics.record runs before the `organizations:preprod-artifact-assemble` feature check, so events are emitted for organizations without the feature. It also reads request.user.id, which can be None for token auth.

findings.title: Error events zipped with ids by position, not by key
findings.body: `zip(error_ids, events.values())` assumes get_multi returns results in the same order as the requested ids. Missing nodes are omitted from the dict, so the remaining events are shifted onto the wrong ids. Using the node-id-to-event mapping directly would avoid this.

findings.title: Validators use truthiness instead of presence
findings.body: validate_timestamp and validate_age check `initial_data.get(...)`, which is falsy for 0. A report with age=0 plus a timestamp passes validation, even though the spec says only one of the two may be present.
